capabilities: Sync shared team libraries backed by GitHub repos silently in the background
Share folders or notes as new libraries with a right-click
Resolve merge conflicts with AI merges or a three-pane review UI
View change history and inline diffs for synced notes
Back up personal notes to a private repo with opt-in sharing
extras: Desktop only (isDesktopOnly). The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Credentials are stored outside the vault, and GitHub access uses a GitHub App with short-lived, repository-scoped tokens.
motivation: The README says it is built for teams where most members are not engineers, so the UI uses knowledge-base language (share / update / resolve) instead of git terminology.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way for teams, especially non-engineers, to share and keep notes in sync without working directly with git.

relations.evidence: subfolders in your vault backed by your organization's GitHub repos

requires.name: LLM provider API key for AI conflict resolution

summary: Team knowledge base client that syncs shared vault folders through GitHub repos, with an LLM agent handling all git operations and conflict merges.
